title: Hayley Smith
description: The mod adds sanity to your game. Fear the darkness lest it come for you.
body:
### **The mod adds sanity to your game. Fear the darkness lest it come for you.**


**Carry a torch or face the consequences.**


**You may encounter strange chests, study books, and search for new secrets together with your friends**

### Who is this mod for?
**Fans of psychological horror games
Players looking for a new challenge
Those who want a darker Minecraft experience
Streamers and content creators
Those who enjoy survival mode**

### Key Features
**Sanity System (0-100%)**

**Sanity decreases in darkness and at night.
Sanity regenerates in light.
Abnormal events occur when sanity decreases.
Visual and audio effects of mental breakdown.**

### Night Mechanics

**Sanity is lost 2-3 times faster at night
Enemies appear more often and become more dangerous
Random night events (strange sounds, visions, voices)
DARKNESS effect during extreme fear**


![chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c3c6409d76be8c2016212e42cfe566c506705db.png)




<details>
<summary>answer to questions</summary>

Q: Does it work on servers?

**A: Yes, the mod has full multiplayer support.**

Q: What mods does it conflict with?

**A: There are usually no conflicts, the mod is well compatible.**

Q: Can I disable certain enemies?

**A: Use the /spawntype and /setsanity commands to control this.**

Q: How do I restore sanity?

**A: The /restoresanity command fully restores sanity.**

</details>
